scheme_name: Reimbursement of Tution Fee for SC/ST/OBC/Min students in Public Schools in Class I to XII
other_conditions: Must be studying in Class 1st to 12th.
Must be enrolled in a school recognized/affiliated with the Dept. of Education, GNCTD or Municipal Local Bodies of Delhi.
Must have scored 50% or above in the previous academic year.
Must have at least 80% attendance in the preceding year.
Must not be repeating the same class.
Family annual income should not exceed ₹2,00,000.
benefits_summary: Maximum reimbursement up to ₹48,000 or actual fees paid for tuition, lab and library charges.
